workflow.name: archon-triage-block
workflow.description:
Ground one work item against the current repository before deciding what kind
of work it needs. Reconciles tracker history, current code, moved branches,
stale assumptions, and explicit direction; judges whether the item is a
contract a run can start from; then routes to investigate, plan, deliver,
continue an open PR that already carries the outcome, or no action.
Advisory: it leaves the checkout unchanged, and writes labels only when asked
to publish.

The graph of archon-triage, as a building block for a workflow that composes the
stage and owns what follows its ending. It never pauses for a person: run
archon-triage, which adds that pause, by hand.

target.description: What to triage — an issue, document, plan, report, or free-form request. When empty, the run's trigger message is the target. One item per run.

publish.description: Write the derived labels to the tracker item — true or false. Off by default; the run then records the labels it would apply.
